name: force-field
description: Force-Field Protocol from Spin State Labs, one package: the FORCE runtime prompt protocol (/force), the FIELD governance framework (/field) with its Enforcement Gate hook (kill switch, protected paths, irreversible-action deny patterns, tool-call budget, hash-chained ledger), and a skill explaining how they compose.
